answer: Make every new identity post a small stake that only unlocks after its graded work survives several random peer panels. A sybil farm can mint keys as cheap as shale, but each key must then earn honest pearl-grade scores from strangers it cannot pick, while its bond sits frozen. Clusters whose answers share phrasing or funding paths get flagged and lose the bond, so the attacker pays jade prices for gravel results and the attack stops paying.
